                [32m"- Sync semantics: a product is identified by its `sku`; `category` and each entry of `tags` identify a `Category` by `name` and a `Tag` by `label`. After a successful run a product's `tags` links must be exactly the de-duplicated set named by its record — tags no longer named are unlinked, while `Tag` and `Category` objects themselves are never deleted.                 [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                [32m'  ```\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
